born.why: This code improves safety by using trait-based analogy (color/smell) from past experiences rather than just species key, allowing Fagi to avoid poisonous variants of known-safe species and safely eat unknown but similar-looking safe fruits, while prioritizing carrying known food when hungry.

The code improves survival by aggregating evidence from both specific species history and shared trait heuristics (color/smell) across the diary, allowing Fagi to make safer decisions with limited data and avoid poisonous fruits that share traits with safe ones.

The code prioritizes safety by requiring multiple samples to confirm a fruit is safe before eating it whole, and uses tasting to gather data on unknown fruits unless starvation is imminent, balancing the risk of poisoning against the risk of hunger.

This code improves survival by leveraging trait-based generalization (assuming same color/shape implies same chemistry) to avoid poisoning from novel species that share traits with known safe ones, and prioritizes eating over tasting when safety is confirmed to maximize caloric intake rate.

The code prioritizes carrying known-safe fruits for future buffer, uses tasting for unknowns to build safety data, and switches to aggressive eating only at critical starvation levels, balancing long-term survival with immediate needs.

This code improves foraging safety by using trait-based inference (matching color/shape) to predict risk for novel fruits based on past experiences with similar species, preventing starvation-driven mistakes while avoiding known poisons.
